title: Groom Club Monthly Late Cancellations Around a Vet Clinic Office Visit
content:
For Groom Club Monthly at the Tailwise Grooming Salon, a club late-cancellation charge is relieved when the pet has recently been seen at a Tailwise Vet Clinic office visit under Tailwise Vet Clinic Wellness Plans.

**Relief.** The clinic relief on the club late-cancellation charge follows the pet's Tailwise Vet Clinic wellness plan and the latest office visit redeemed on it, counted in calendar days from that office visit to the cancelled appointment date — the appointment date on the most recently recorded cancellation on the club with a fee remedy:

- a plan in status active whose latest office visit falls 0 to 2 days before the appointment gives 100 percent;
- a plan in status active whose latest office visit falls more than 2 and no more than 14 days before the appointment gives 50 percent;
- any other case gives none.

Telehealth consultations, wellness exams and other services are not office visits. The clinic relief percentage reduces the club late-cancellation charge once.

**Combinations**

| Plan status | Latest office visit before the appointment | Relief |
|---|---|---|
| active | 0, 1 or 2 days | 100 percent |
| active | 3 to 14 days | 50 percent |
| active | 15 days or more, after the appointment, or none redeemed | none |
| not active, or no plan | any | none |

**Examples (hypothetical charge of 43.995 before the relief, appointment on 12 August)**

- Active plan, office visit redeemed 10 August (2 days before): 100 percent; nothing is charged.
- Active plan, office visit redeemed 1 August (11 days before): 50 percent; 21.9975 before the final rounding.
- Active plan, a telehealth consultation on 11 August and the latest office visit on 20 July (23 days before): none.
